stem: Which lines from the poem best show the effects of the shoemaker’s efforts over time?

options.label: F
options.text: Nothing’s changed much, except the front/is a shoe store complete with fancy mirrors, (lines 3–4)

options.label: G
options.text: no more bald/than he was then, (lines 12–13)

options.label: H
options.text: working a pair of pumps/back and forth with complete absorption, (lines 15–16)

options.label: J
options.text: Well, he’s prospered,/no longer lives above the store. (lines 27–28)
